_about: One entry per tested build of a program, keyed by the SHA-256 of its main executable (the companion tool prints it). 'status' is one of: playable, ingame, menus, boots, nothing. Reports are per device; 'reports' lists them newest first.

titles.title: Halo 2
titles.summary: Menus, campaign and multiplayer run at the game's 30 frames per second. Occasional lighting and post-processing errors remain on the phone's graphics path; not every level has been played.
known_issues: Some areas render too dark or too bright on the phone
Some levels have not been tested and may hang
Frame-rate dips while new textures load
No online play, no hardware controllers

reports.notes: Slayer on a multiplayer map and the campaign were played; see known issues.
